method: Primary repository and official documentation review. Patterns are implemented locally; upstream source code is not vendored or automatically executed.

sources.observedResult: Documents per-agent installation directories and SHA-256 tracking that preserves modified integration files.
sources.adoptedPattern: Track ownership and installed hashes, plan changes first, and block upgrades when managed files have local edits.
sources.limitation: This is evidence for the installation design, not a measured productivity improvement for this kit.

sources.observedResult: Ships composable workflow skills, debugging procedures, and an explicit verification-before-completion skill.
sources.adoptedPattern: Require executed verification evidence and structured acceptance cases instead of generic completion claims.
sources.limitation: No claim that its agent methodology has been independently benchmarked here; no upstream skill text is copied.

sources.observedResult: Documents repository packing, ignore rules, and secret detection before context sharing.
sources.adoptedPattern: Keep repository context local, exclude sensitive/generated files, and review packed output before sharing.
sources.limitation: Scanning and ignore rules cannot guarantee that all sensitive content is excluded. Existing integration is retained.

sources.observedResult: Provides command-output filtering and a gain command to inspect token savings.
sources.adoptedPattern: Probe the official executable and measure actual local output savings rather than promising a universal percentage.
sources.limitation: Upstream savings claims do not measure this kit's end-to-end model cost, latency, or software quality.
